title: Imp Catcher (historical)
start: Wizards' Tower, on the floor 2 (ascend the beam once), talk to Wizard Mizgog.

items.t: These items listed below can be obtained during the quest:

steps.t: To start, go to the Wizards' Tower South of Draynor Village and talk to Wizard Mizgog on the floor 2.
Kill imps anywhere in RuneScape until all four beads are found, or you could buy all four beads at the Grand Exchange
p: A player giving Wizard Mizgog the four beads

get_inside.text: The entrance to the modern-day Wizards' Tower.
pic: The entrance to the modern-day Wizards' Tower.

get_inside.text: Use a wicked hood or infinity ethereal outfit for unlimited teleportation to the roof of the tower
Use stardust in the currency pouch to teleport to the floor 3 next to Wizard Rosalina (after talking to her about the stardust)
Use a traveller's necklace to arrive at the entrance of the tower

Use the code DIS on the fairy ring network to arrive south of the tower. There is also a portal on the floor 3 (eastern portal) of the Wizards' Guild in Yanille offering direct teleportation to the floor 1 arriving at the centre of the tower next to the beam.
Use the elder divination outfit to teleport to the pale wisp colony and run south-west
Use an amulet of glory to teleport to Draynor Village square and run south or use the Draynor lodestone and run south
Enter any runecrafting altar and speak to the wizard located inside. At the end of the conversation, you will receive a prompt to teleport to the roof of the tower.
